nodes.text: I'm going to say a thing I've only said twice, and I restocked for both of them after. There's a den in the deep wood off the hunter's trail. A matriarch runs it — dire, old, and every pack for miles answers her.

choices.text: What happened to the other two?
I like my straps and my life.

nodes.text: One's lying in front of the den. The other doesn't hunt anymore. _I'm not selling you a story with a good ending. I'm telling you the price._

choices.text: I like my straps and my life.

nodes.text: Break the packs between you and the den first, or you fight all of them at her door. Then her. Bring the pelt whole — not for coin. I'll work it into something worth what it cost.
That's the answer that keeps my restock bill down. Offer stands.
